SELECT DISTINCT g.stable_id AS ensembl_gene_id, x.dbprimary_acc AS entrez_id FROM gene AS g JOIN object_xref AS ox ON ox.ensembl_object_type = 'Gene' AND ox.ensembl_id = g.gene_id JOIN xref AS x ON x.xref_id = ox.xref_id JOIN external_db AS ed ON ed.external_db_id = x.external_db_id WHERE ed.db_name = 'EntrezGene' AND g.stable_id LIKE 'ENSG%' ORDER BY g.stable_id, x.dbprimary_acc

SELECT h.homology_id, h.gene_tree_root_id, r.stable_id AS gene_tree_id, r.version AS gene_tree_version, r.member_type, r.tree_type, r.clusterset_id FROM homology AS h LEFT JOIN gene_tree_root AS r ON r.root_id = h.gene_tree_root_id WHERE h.homology_id IN (batched homology IDs from both frozen species extracts) ORDER BY h.homology_id
